dataList.content: <Really? What's a defendant supposed to look like at a normal trial?>
<*sigh* But he doesn't even have a lawyer to do that for him...>
<She really is going to be his lawyer...?>
<... I'm not sure if he knows that himself?>
<Am I... Am I hearing this right...?>
<... Maybe Faust... was never trying to save Meursault to begin with.>
